note.summary:
3.2 Media and technology
Key focus
- social media, online safety, devices, communication and digital habits.

Core language
- Useful structures: secondo me; penso che; mi piace perché; l’anno scorso; in futuro; di solito; dovrei/dovremmo.
- Use negatives carefully, give advantages and drawbacks, and distinguish direct speech from reported opinions.

Exam tips
- For comprehension, locate the exact word or phrase that proves each answer.
- In translation, preserve tense, negatives, quantities and relationships between people.
- In writing, add opinions and reasons, vary time frames, and check verb and adjective agreement.

questions.examTip: Keep nouns and adjectives in agreement, use the correct article, and preserve the tense of each English sentence.
questions.modelAnswer: Uso il telefono per parlare con i miei amici e controllare gli orari.
questions.question:
Translate into Italian:

I use my phone to talk to friends and check timetables.

My sister spends three hours a day on social media, perhaps too much.

Translate into Italian:

questions.examTip: Cover every bullet, use a past and a future reference where relevant, and support each opinion with perché.
questions.modelAnswer:
Uso il telefono per parlare con i miei amici e controllare gli orari. Mia sorella trascorre tre ore al giorno sui social, forse troppe. Ieri ho scaricato un’app che mi aiuta a imparare il vocabolario. Secondo me è importante e vorrei provare un’esperienza diversa in futuro.

(English translation: I use my phone to talk to friends and check timetables. My sister spends three hours a day on social media, perhaps too much. Yesterday I downloaded an app that helps me learn vocabulary. In my opinion it is important, and I would like to try a different experience in the future.)
